title: Add Aldea user config and resolve_aldea_api_key for STT
description: Part of Biblicus-shs (Aldea STT epic). Add AldeaUserConfig (api_key) in src/biblicus/user_config.py, add aldea: Optional[AldeaUserConfig] to BiblicusUserConfig, implement resolve_aldea_api_key(): check ALDEA_API_KEY first, then config.aldea.api_key. Document in docs/user-configuration.md (section Example: Aldea speech to text, same pattern as Deepgram/OpenAI). No new optional dependency; config only.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter
